ordering and ties when requested.query_evidence: ORDER BY refCount DESC, tr.trNumber LIMIT 5

population and source context.assessment: REFERENCES_TR 인용 기록 수에 따른 TR 상위 5개
population and source context.original_derivation: List the top 5 most-referenced TRs (most-cited studies).
population and source context.query_evidence: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) WITH tr, count(ref) AS refCount
